svg.title: A field for a secret says what is wrong, and takes a paste
svg.desc: Findings 8 and 9 · by reading · the lock screen after a password that failed, and the box that asks for a key's passphrase A discussion mockup drawn by hand from the built-in theme's colours, not a screenshot.
svg.text: A field for a secret says what is wrong, and takes a paste
Findings 8 and 9 · by reading · the lock screen after a password that failed, and the box that asks for a key's passphrase
NOW
“That was not right”, and no more
DIRECTION
Why it was not right, and a way round
1 The lock screen, Caps Lock on, the Polish layout in use
A
Ada
That was not right
Caps Lock is on. Nothing says so, here or in either box
Which layout is in use is not said, and its key is dead while locked
The key that woke the screen was not typed (ADR 52)
What was typed cannot be looked at; the boxes have an eye
Three such tries, and pam_faillock locks the account
2 A key's passphrase, which lives in a password manager
GnuPG asks for the passphrase of a key
Ada <ada@example.org>
That passphrase was not right.
Unlock
Cancel
pressed:
Super
V
→ nothing
Paste is a key that does nothing: “they give nothing to copy”
With the box up, no other program can be looked at or typed in
So a long passphrase is copied by eye, or onto paper (WCAG 3.3.8)
What went wrong is dim, with no sign; a key's box does not shake
Two typings of a new one that differ: nothing is said at all
1 The lock screen, Caps Lock on, the Polish layout in use
A
Ada
PL
That was not right
Caps Lock is on
Caps Lock said in words, in every field for a secret
The layout beside the field: a press or its key changes it
The eye, as the boxes have; what went wrong in red, after a sign
The first key typed as well as waking the screen
--danger on the ground is 6.1 to 1; on a box, 5.5
2 A key's passphrase, which lives in a password manager
GnuPG asks for the passphrase of a key
Ada <ada@example.org>
That passphrase was not right.
Unlock
Cancel
pressed:
Super
V
→ the first line of what was copied
Pasting in gives nothing away; copying out stays impossible
The clipboard is already offered to whatever has the keyboard
What went wrong after a sign, in a colour kept for it
“The two were not the same”, when they were not
The lock screen can stay without paste: nothing is behind it
